fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: To enter Mexico, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.
entry.es: Para entrar a México, tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda tu estancia.
entry.quote: To enter Mexico, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

entry.en: Tourists visiting Mexico do not need a visa and get a passport stamp showing the number of days they may stay.
entry.es: Los turistas que visitan México no necesitan visa y reciben un sello en el pasaporte con el número de días que pueden quedarse.
entry.quote: If you’re visiting Mexico as a tourist, you do not need a visa. You’ll get a stamp in your passport with the number of days you are allowed to stay.

entry.en: British nationals entering Mexico by land must fill in an immigration form online.
entry.es: Los ciudadanos británicos que entran a México por tierra deben llenar un formulario de inmigración en línea.
entry.quote: British nationals entering Mexico by land must fill in an immigration form online.

entry.en: At Mexican border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo mexicano puede que tengas que mostrar un boleto de regreso o de continuación.
entry.quote: At Mexican border control, you may need to: - show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: If you have goods to declare, you must submit a customs form online before travelling to Mexico.
entry.es: Si tienes bienes que declarar, debes enviar un formulario de aduana en línea antes de viajar a México.
entry.quote: If you have goods to declare, you must submit a customs form online before travelling to Mexico.

entry.en: You must pay an entry tax to visit the state of Quintana Roo, either online before or during your stay.
entry.es: Debes pagar un impuesto de entrada para visitar el estado de Quintana Roo, en línea antes o durante tu estancia.
entry.quote: You must pay an entry tax to visit the state of Quintana Roo – you can pay the entry tax online before or during your stay.

safety.en: Crime is a risk to foreign nationals in Mexico, particularly in major cities and tourist resort areas, where street crime is a serious issue.
safety.es: El crimen es un riesgo para los extranjeros en México, sobre todo en las grandes ciudades y zonas turísticas, donde el crimen callejero es un problema serio.
safety.quote: Crime is a risk to foreign nationals in Mexico, particularly in major cities and tourist resort areas. Street crime is a serious issue in these places.

safety.en: Some genuine police officers have extorted money from tourists for alleged minor offences or traffic violations.
safety.es: Algunos policías auténticos han extorsionado a turistas por supuestas faltas menores o infracciones de tránsito.
safety.quote: Some genuine police officers have extorted money from tourists for alleged minor offences or traffic violations.

safety.en: Unlicensed taxi drivers have robbed and assaulted passengers, so use authorised ‘sitio’ taxis or ask your hotel to order one.
safety.es: Taxistas sin licencia han asaltado y agredido a pasajeros, así que usa taxis de sitio autorizados o pide uno en tu hotel.
safety.quote: Unlicensed taxi drivers have robbed and assaulted passengers, including in Mexico City. Use the better regulated ‘sitio’ taxis from authorised taxi ranks or ask your hotel to order you a taxi.

safety.en: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Mexico.
safety.es: Ha habido muertes y casos de enfermedad grave por bebidas alcohólicas con metanol en México.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Mexico.

safety.en: Drug-related violence affects the northern states of Sonora, Chihuahua, Coahuila, Nuevo Leon, Tamaulipas, Sinaloa and Durango.
safety.es: La violencia relacionada con las drogas afecta a los estados del norte: Sonora, Chihuahua, Coahuila, Nuevo León, Tamaulipas, Sinaloa y Durango.
safety.quote: Drug-related violence affects the northern states of Sonora, Chihuahua, Coahuila, Nuevo Leon, Tamaulipas, Sinaloa and Durango.

safety.en: Women travelling alone on public transport have been harassed, robbed and sexually assaulted.
safety.es: Mujeres que viajan solas en transporte público han sido acosadas, robadas y agredidas sexualmente.
safety.quote: Women travelling alone on public transport have been harassed, robbed and sexually assaulted.

health.en: Only drink boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.
health.es: Bebe solo agua hervida o embotellada y evita el hielo en las bebidas.
health.quote: Only drink boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.

health.en: Outside of state capitals and larger urban areas, medical and emergency services may be limited.
health.es: Fuera de las capitales estatales y las zonas urbanas grandes, los servicios médicos y de emergencia pueden ser limitados.
health.quote: Outside of state capitals and larger urban areas, medical and emergency services may be limited.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Mexico.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas partes de México.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Mexico.

health.en: Not all hospitals deal directly with insurers, so be prepared to pay up front and then get a refund.
health.es: No todos los hospitales tratan directamente con aseguradoras, así que prepárate para pagar por adelantado y luego pedir un reembolso.
health.quote: Not all hospitals will agree to deal directly with medical insurance companies. Be prepared to pay for treatment yourself up front and then get a refund.

health.en: Prescriptions issued outside Mexico must be translated into Spanish.
health.es: Las recetas emitidas fuera de México deben traducirse al español.
health.quote: You must get prescriptions issued outside of Mexico translated into Spanish.

health.en: Vaccination against Hepatitis A & B and Typhoid fever is recommended.
health.es: Se recomienda la vacunación contra la hepatitis A y B y la fiebre tifoidea.
health.quote: Vaccination against Hepatitis A & B and Typhoid fever is recommended.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 911.

help.en: The Mexico City Tourist Police can be reached by telephone on (0052) 55 5207 4155.
help.es: La Policía Turística de la Ciudad de México atiende en el teléfono (0052) 55 5207 4155.

help.en: Mexico City’s public telephone service LOCATEL (5658 1111) has English-speaking staff available.
help.es: El servicio telefónico público de la Ciudad de México LOCATEL (5658 1111) cuenta con personal que habla inglés.
help.quote: you can contact Mexico City’s public telephone service LOCATEL on 5658 1111 (English-speaking staff available).

help.en: Crimes should be reported immediately at the nearest state prosecutor’s office (Agencia del Ministerio Público).
help.es: Los delitos deben denunciarse de inmediato en la oficina de la fiscalía estatal más cercana (Agencia del Ministerio Público).
help.quote: If you want to report a crime, do so immediately at the nearest branch of the state prosecutor’s office (‘Agencia del Ministerio Público’).

getting_in.en: Citizens of many countries can fill out a tourist card (FMM) at the border or on landing for stays of fewer than 180 days for tourism.
getting_in.es: Los ciudadanos de muchos países pueden llenar una tarjeta de turista (FMM) en la frontera o al aterrizar para estancias de menos de 180 días por turismo.
getting_in.quote: Foreign nationals of many countries who intend to stay in Mexico fewer than 180 days for the purpose of tourism or 30 days for business can fill out a Forma Migratoria Múltiple (FMM, tourist card)

getting_in.en: If you fly in on a commercial flight, your ticket already includes the FMM cost (M$860).
getting_in.es: Si llegas en un vuelo comercial, tu boleto ya incluye el costo de la FMM (M$860).
getting_in.quote: If you fly into Mexico on a commercial flight, your ticket already includes the cost (M$860) of the FMM and you absolutely do not need to pay it again upon exiting.

getting_in.en: Always check your passport stamp and FMM card on arrival to see how many days you were granted.
getting_in.es: Revisa siempre el sello del pasaporte y la tarjeta FMM al llegar para saber cuántos días te otorgaron.
getting_in.quote: Always check your passport stamp and FMM card upon arrival to determine how many days are granted before walking away from the immigration counter.

getting_in.en: Most commercial airlines link Mexico directly from Europe, with direct flights to Mexico City (MEX) and Cancun (CUN).
getting_in.es: La mayoría de las aerolíneas comerciales conectan México directamente desde Europa, con vuelos directos a Ciudad de México (MEX) y Cancún (CUN).
getting_in.quote: Most commercial airlines link Mexico directly from Europe. There are direct flights to Mexico City (MEX IATA) and Cancun (CUN IATA)

getting_in.en: There are hundreds of daily flights linking Mexico to cities large and small throughout North America.
getting_in.es: Hay cientos de vuelos diarios que conectan México con ciudades grandes y pequeñas de toda Norteamérica.
getting_in.quote: There are hundreds of daily flights linking Mexico to cities large and small throughout North America.

getting_in.en: If you cross by road, you must locate the border office yourself, as authorities will not automatically signal you to fill out paperwork.
getting_in.es: Si cruzas por carretera, debes localizar tú mismo la oficina fronteriza, pues las autoridades no te indicarán automáticamente que llenes los trámites.
getting_in.quote: If you cross the border via road, do not expect the authorities to automatically signal you to fill out your paperwork. You will have to locate the border office yourself.

getting_around.en: Travelling in Mexico is most practical by bus, car, or air.
getting_around.es: Viajar por México es más práctico en autobús, auto o avión.
getting_around.quote: Travelling in Mexico is most practical by bus, car, or air.

getting_around.en: The best roads are toll roads, which can be relatively costly but are much faster and better maintained.
getting_around.es: Las mejores carreteras son las de cuota, que pueden ser relativamente caras pero son mucho más rápidas y están mejor mantenidas.
getting_around.quote: the best roads are toll roads. Toll roads can be relatively costly but are much faster and better maintained.

getting_around.en: US vehicle insurance is not valid in Mexico, and Mexican auto insurance has been required since 2018.
getting_around.es: El seguro de auto de EE. UU. no es válido en México, y el seguro mexicano es obligatorio desde 2018.
getting_around.quote: US vehicle insurance is not valid in Mexico. Mexican auto insurance has been required since 2018; if you have even a minor accident without insurance, you could land in jail.

getting_around.en: Tourists are often warned about travelling on roads at night, especially in rural areas.
getting_around.es: A los turistas se les advierte a menudo que eviten viajar de noche por carretera, sobre todo en zonas rurales.
getting_around.quote: Tourists are often warned about travelling on roads at night. Although bandidos are rare in more metropolitan areas, err on the side of caution in more rural areas.

getting_around.en: Executive and first-class long-distance buses are described as very modern, clean and comfortable.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses de larga distancia ejecutivos y de primera clase se describen como muy modernos, limpios y cómodos.
getting_around.quote: Long-distance buses are an ideal way to experience Mexico. The executive and first-class buses are very modern, clean, and comfortable

getting_around.en: Budget airlines offer fares that rival bus travel over long distances; the low-cost airlines are VivaAerobus and Volaris.
getting_around.es: Las aerolíneas económicas ofrecen tarifas que rivalizan con el autobús en largas distancias; las de bajo costo son VivaAerobus y Volaris.
getting_around.quote: Budget airlines offer competitive fares that rival bus travel over long distances. The low-cost airlines are VivaAerobus and Volaris.

money.en: The currency of Mexico is the peso (ISO code MXN), denoted as $.
money.es: La moneda de México es el peso (código ISO MXN), representado con $.
money.quote: The currency of Mexico is the peso, denoted in Mexico as "$" (ISO code MXN)

money.en: Cards can be used at ATMs and in most department stores, bigger restaurants and gas stations, but outside cities you should carry enough pesos in cash.
money.es: Las tarjetas se pueden usar en cajeros y en la mayoría de las tiendas departamentales, restaurantes grandes y gasolineras, pero fuera de las ciudades conviene llevar suficiente efectivo en pesos.
money.quote: You can use them at ATMs as well as in most department stores, bigger restaurants, gas stations, but be sure that outside cities you always carry sufficient cash in pesos

money.en: Most of the time, an extra 5% is added when paying with a card.
money.es: La mayoría de las veces se añade un 5% extra al pagar con tarjeta.
money.quote: Most of the time, an extra 5% when paying with card is added.

money.en: Merchants may accept US dollars at a lower exchange rate.
money.es: Los comercios pueden aceptar dólares estadounidenses a un tipo de cambio más bajo.
money.quote: Merchants may accept US dollars at a lower exchange rate.

money.en: Merchants in small markets (tianguis) and street vendors are used to haggling.
money.es: Los comerciantes de mercados pequeños (tianguis) y los vendedores ambulantes están acostumbrados a regatear.
money.quote: Merchants, specially those in small markets ("tianguis") and street vendors are no strangers to haggling.

money.en: It is generally safer to use ATMs during daylight hours inside shops or malls.
money.es: Por lo general es más seguro usar cajeros automáticos de día y dentro de tiendas o centros comerciales.
money.quote: It’s generally safer to use ATMs during daylight hours inside shops or malls.

etiquette.en: Mexicans have a somewhat relaxed sense of time, so patience is vital.
etiquette.es: Los mexicanos tienen un sentido del tiempo algo relajado, así que es fundamental tener paciencia.
etiquette.quote: Mexicans have a somewhat relaxed sense of time so it's vital to be patient.

etiquette.en: When anyone sneezes, even a stranger, you always say "¡salud!"; otherwise it is considered rude.
etiquette.es: Cuando alguien estornuda, incluso un desconocido, siempre se dice «¡salud!»; de lo contrario se considera de mala educación.
etiquette.quote: When anyone, even a total stranger, sneezes, you always say "¡salud!" ("bless you!" or more literally, "your health!"): otherwise, it is considered rude.

etiquette.en: When entering churches, always take off any sunglasses, caps or hats.
etiquette.es: Al entrar en iglesias, quítate siempre los lentes de sol, gorras o sombreros.
etiquette.quote: When entering churches, always take off any sunglasses, caps or hats.

etiquette.en: Offering a bribe to an official may get you into trouble.
etiquette.es: Ofrecer un soborno a un funcionario puede meterte en problemas.
etiquette.quote: Offering a bribe to an official may get you into trouble.

etiquette.en: Attitudes towards LGBT travellers can be hostile in more rural states, but Mexico City and popular beach resorts are very LGBT friendly.
etiquette.es: Las actitudes hacia los viajeros LGBT pueden ser hostiles en estados más rurales, pero la Ciudad de México y los centros de playa populares son muy amigables con la comunidad LGBT.
etiquette.quote: Attitudes towards LGBT travellers can be hostile in more rural states, but Mexico City is very LGBT friendly as are popular beach resort areas such as Cancun, Puerto Vallarta, and Acapulco.

etiquette.en: Sensitive subjects like illegal immigration to the US, crime, or the drug war are likely to arouse strong emotions.
etiquette.es: Temas delicados como la inmigración ilegal a EE. UU., el crimen o la guerra contra las drogas probablemente despierten emociones fuertes.
etiquette.quote: sensitive subjects like illegal immigration to the US, crime, or the drug war are likely to arouse strong emotions.

connectivity.en: With an unlocked GSM phone you can buy a prepaid SIM card in Mexico; Telcel provides good coverage throughout the country.
connectivity.es: Con un teléfono GSM desbloqueado puedes comprar una SIM de prepago en México; Telcel ofrece buena cobertura en todo el país.
connectivity.quote: If you have an unlocked GSM phone, you can buy a prepaid SIM card in Mexico. The most expensive provider Telcel provides good coverage throughout the country.

connectivity.en: A Telcel amigo express SIM card cost M$29 in November 2021, e.g. in an Oxxo store.
connectivity.es: Una SIM Telcel amigo express costaba M$29 en noviembre de 2021, por ejemplo en una tienda Oxxo.
connectivity.quote: A SIM card for the Telcel brand amigo express is for M$29 (Nov 2021) e.g., in an Oxxo store.

connectivity.en: You can make free international calls with an app like WhatsApp or Telegram once connected to Wi-Fi.
connectivity.es: Puedes hacer llamadas internacionales gratis con una app como WhatsApp o Telegram al conectarte a una red Wi-Fi.
connectivity.quote: You can make international calls free if you have an app like WhatsApp or Telegram and connect to Wi-fi before using it.

connectivity.en: There is a wireless internet connection in almost every restaurant in the big cities.
connectivity.es: Hay conexión inalámbrica a internet en casi todos los restaurantes de las grandes ciudades.
connectivity.quote: There is a wireless internet connection in almost every restaurant in the big cities.
